content.text: {"decision": "explain", "likely_cause": "Likely cause: a visible error appears on the Counterparty field of the Ir Swap screen shortly after focus, and in both sessions the user then leaves for Static Data and returns to Ir Swap through the Trades/tab menu, which would explain the repeated Ir Swap navigations in the same task.", "fix": "Fix: On the Ir Swap screen, change the Counterparty input's error state so it offers an inline counterparty search or create action (or a lookup dropdown) instead of leaving the user to find Static Data > Counterparty in the top menu, so the task does not need a round trip through another screen.", "cited_event_ids": ["64:a70", "95", "app:13", "126", "app:15", "63:a72", "app:21", "app:23"], "confidence": "med", "unsupported": ["The text or cause of the error message is not in the events (only that an error became visible).", "Whether the Static Data visit was made to resolve the Counterparty error is inferred from timing and order, not observed.", "Whether entered values (Trade Date, Notional) persist after returning to Ir Swap is not shown.", "The return path via the Trades/tab menu may be ordinary navigation rather than a return caused by the error.", "The sampled windows cover only about 22 seconds per session, so the full task flow is not visible."]}
